sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

# Player seems stuck. Let me check current position and try DOWN then UP again
seg = current_frame.segmentation
player_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'P']
print("Current player position:")
for n in player_nodes:
    b = n['boundary']
    min_r, max_r = min(p[0] for p in b), max(p[0] for p in b)
    min_c, max_c = min(p[1] for p in b), max(p[1] for p in b)
    print(f"  id={n['id']}, pixels={n['pixels']}, bbox=[{min_r},{min_c}]-[{max_r},{max_c}]")

# Check what's directly above the player
ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("\nArea above player (rows 35-44, cols 19-26):")
for r in range(35, 44):
    if r < len(ascii_lines):
        print(f"{r:2d}: {ascii_lines[r][19:27]}")

# Try DOWN first, then UP
action(['DOWN'])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
